digest_preview.note: Numbers only; the commentary is written by Claude (plan 2.4). score = views ÷ the channel's expected views at the latest checkpoint (≥ 3× is a breakout).

rss_lag.how_to_read: For each RSS reading, lag = how many minutes earlier the Data API already had that view count (interpolated between two API readings of the same video). young_lag_min covers videos under 48 h, where it matters. gap_pct = how far below the API count RSS was when both were read within 10 minutes. Verdict: collecting (fewer than 12 samples), rss-ok (median lag ≤ 60 min), rss-lags (> 60 min: the hourly API readings carry the first 48 h; plan 2.2).
